entities.summary: Joani Blank was an American feminist sex educator, entrepreneur, and author in the field of sexuality. She is the founder of Good Vibrations and Down There Press. She used publishing, her sex store, and other endeavors to promote sex-positive feminism. Her papers are part of the Human Sexuality Collection at Cornell University Library.
